notes: Server-time dates (America/Los_Angeles) for WoW: Forever. The Darkmoon Faire dates were read from the game client by Bind on Forever; the battleground holiday weeks (Call to Arms) come from Wowhead's Forever calendar (Nov 9, 2026). Wowhead lists no other dated world events for Forever yet. Add other events only with a source, each with verified, source and (if unverified) a note.

darkmoon-faire.note: Client data from build 1.60.1.70707 (Oct 30, 2026), not announced by Blizzard and may change. Each visit lasts a week; time of day is assumed (00:00 server time, as on Anniversary).
